items.title: Hide Tanaka interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 3, 2014
items.q: Ray Brown, Sam Jones, Paul Chambers. I love their rhythm.

ctx.x: Who are your three favorite bass players?
Ray Brown, Sam Jones, Paul Chambers. I love their rhythm.

Yes. I can tell. A bass player I think has to have a certain — they have to have their ego in place. I mean that’s my sense of it. You have to be happy providing — as Milt Hinton called it, “providing a rhythmic service” and then you’ll have your moments in the spotlight too.
